lines.en: One stride carries me down the whole tunnel.
The stone wall gives way at my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是因为不必快。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I need not hurry.
The slab under me splits in two.
Vapor spreads out along my path.
I patrol the veins as if they were my land.

lines.zh: 这具身体太重，地面下沉。
lines.en: This body is heavy; the ground sinks.
As I pass, the lamp flames lean.
The ceiling is low; I walk bent.
I crush gravel without looking down.
My shadow trails long behind me.
I walk from the water to the fire.

lines.zh: 我在听石头深处的回音。
lines.en: I listen to echoes deep in the stone.
This lamp burns cheaper than most.

lines.zh: 我数过这座矿的每一层。
lines.en: I have counted every layer of this mine.
Wisdom is an exhausting thing to carry.
Vapor beads between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我能听见你还没问的问题。
lines.en: I hear the question you have not asked.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人多半后悔了。
lines.en: Most who summon me come to regret it.
I do not sleep; I lower my fire.

lines.zh: 矿里的空气有铁的味道。
lines.en: The mine air tastes of iron.

lines.zh: 我在算下一处矿脉在哪。
lines.en: I am calculating where the next vein lies.
Even the highest rank has idle hours.
My fire does not burn my master.

lines.zh: 我在等一句值得回答的话。
lines.en: I wait for a question worth answering.
This mine is quiet; I like that.

lines.zh: 这层矿的石头比上面硬。
lines.en: The stone on this level is harder than above.
I draw my fire down to a small ball.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，人不该这样。
lines.en: You stand too close; mortals should not.
The fire in your eyes is borrowed, yes?
I know the lines of a summoning circle.
You came with others; that is wise.
Chalk dust still clings to your hands.
I read you like an old book.
I will hear your wishes selectively.
Your heartbeat has quickened a little.
Do not stare too long; it tires you.

lines.zh: 你手里的粉笔还在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: The chalk in your hand still trembles; I see it.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的灵体的味道。
lines.en: You carry another spirit's scent.
I am watching whether you dare command.

lines.zh: 你比我矮，但你说话算数。
lines.en: You are shorter, but your word holds.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我已经记住了。
lines.en: I have already memorized your name.
I charge this wound to your account.
You dared to touch the strongest?
The fire flickered; it did not die.
This pain is an ant's bite.
My form has thinned a little.
Good; you have earned my attention.
Stone feels pain too; you did not know.
I step back to give you a chance.

lines.zh: 元素之躯晃了一下，还没散。
lines.en: My elemental body swayed, but it hasn't scattered.
You have hurt a spirit.
That ore is better than any food.
With what would you bribe the strongest?
Lamp oil? I do not lack for it.
The thing in your hand glows.

lines.zh: 我闻到了深层石的味道。
lines.en: I smell deepstone on you.

lines.zh: 这点东西，不够换我的力气。
lines.en: That is not enough to buy my strength.
I am considering, not agreeing.
Point me to the vein you mean.
I step forward; the ground moves.

lines.zh: 好吧，我看在这块石头上。
lines.en: Fine, I will do it for that stone.
Hitting me is hitting a stone wall.
You stepped back; good.
My body carries no warmth at all.
Do not touch my ring of fire.

lines.zh: 你撞在雾气上，跌了一步。
lines.en: You struck vapor and stumbled a step.
Not on purpose; I am simply heavy.
Stand steady; do not make me catch you.
Your shoulder got singed.

lines.zh: 我的水汽身子从你身上穿过去。
lines.en: My misty body passes straight through you.
We pass; flagstones crack under us.
Stone and fire breed no offspring.

lines.zh: 我们的结合要两座火山。
lines.en: Our union would take two volcanoes.
I came alone, without a partner.
Mortals dare ask such questions.
Spirits are bound by pacts, not bonds.
I have lived too long to want that.

lines.zh: 你去找石头里的那种火。
lines.en: Go find the fire that lives in stone.

lines.zh: 我的婚约写在旧契约里。
lines.en: My betrothal is written in an old pact.
This is not a thing to ask me.

lines.zh: 若要后代，得再造一个我。
lines.en: For offspring, another me must be made.
I pick it up only for you.
This stone fits my hand neatly.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，东西自己上来。
lines.en: I do not bend; the object rises.
The rubble in this tunnel is mine.
I could lift the entire cart.
Do not make me gather rubbish.
Eight blocks at once is enough.
My hands char the wood I hold.
Set it on my palm, not the floor.
This one I will deliver for you.
That thing is at the tunnel's end.
I choose my target without hesitation.
Its bones are hard; I like that.
You are blocking my line of sight.

lines.zh: 那头怪的重量我算过了。
lines.en: I have calculated that beast's weight.
What I fix on rarely escapes.
My master wants it dead; so be it.
First I will seal its escape route.
This one is mine; do not interfere.
Its scent is old, like stone.

lines.zh: 我能听出它几步之后的位置。
lines.en: I can hear where it will be in a few steps.
Target chosen; the fire is lit.
I move first; keep up.
It should not be on this layer.
The fire ring tightens; I am ready.
I am in no hurry; it has already lost.

lines.zh: 再近三步，就是我的距离。
lines.en: Three steps closer and it is my range.

lines.zh: 它在算退路，我算它的命。
lines.en: It counts exits; I count its life.

lines.zh: 灯焰往我这边倒，它该退了。
lines.en: The lamp flame bends toward me; it should retreat.
Stand back; the fire will spread.

lines.zh: 我给它留一条活路，好看。
lines.en: I leave it one way out, for show.

lines.zh: 它的手在抖，和刚才的你一样。
lines.en: Its hand trembles, just as yours did.
I raise my hand very slowly.

lines.zh: 我掌心压着热风，等它先动。
lines.en: Heat gathers in my palm; I wait for it to move first.
It thinks I cannot see its flank.
The mist arrives first; I follow.
I wait for its nerve to break first.
Stand still; it will be quicker.

lines.zh: 我先开口，它就没机会了。
lines.en: I speak first, so it never gets a chance.
One palm strike, and it remembers forever.

lines.zh: 我的拳落在石上，石碎了。
lines.en: My fist lands on stone; stone breaks.
Fire runs from my palm to its chest.
It did not even finish its cry.
This is not a fight; it is tidying up.
Weight is my whole argument.
I strike until its bones ring.
Back off; I will strike again.

lines.zh: 我留了力气，怕震塌矿道。
lines.en: I held back, lest the tunnel collapse.
It falls with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 阵线亮了，我从火里出来。
lines.en: The circle glows; I step out of fire.

lines.zh: 你们几个人围着我，怕吗。
lines.en: Several of you ring me; are you afraid?
The chalk dust has not settled yet.
The strongest is here; wish carefully.
I come through the smoke and stand.
Steady hands performed this summoning.
I smell lamp oil and iron.
The pact burns hot in my chest.
The mortal world again, and tunnels.
I have come; you have paid the price.
Do not kneel; I do not take that.
Fire lands first; then I do.
Call me by the name of the strongest.

lines.zh: 阵里的火立起来，我踩着灰走出。
lines.en: The fire in the circle rises and I step out of the ash.
Fire against fire does nothing.
I fall from height; the ground breaks first.
Water is my old home; do not bother.
The blast pushed me back ten feet.
The arrow passes through, taking only mist.
The spell slid off my body.
Spirits do not starve; we only fade.
Lightning claims kinship; it is far off.
The void presses me; I press back.
